data.narrative:
Western Chemicals is a pre-seed stage climate & energy company founded by Jared West (Columbia physics and mechanical engineering, class of 2020). The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private firms and 1 public company in the Climate & Energy sector, including peers like Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable technique, given insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables to support a narrow peer-median approach. Using Western Chemicals' $175K total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Pre-Seed to next-stage progression yields $438K. A Peer-Median approach was not viable: while 8 same-sector peers exist, none satisfied narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier), and an all-sector median would introduce material selection bias.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $372K to $503K, with a median of $438K. This range reflects the single applicable method and derives confidence primarily from stage-appropriate multiplier application rather than peer verification. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct comparable transactions at this stage and lack of technology/commercial traction data. Investors should weight this valuation as preliminary, pending additional market intelligence or observable early milestones that would enable peer-median triangulation.
